newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFC stock price rise halted for second day.
newsitem.headline: RFC stock price rise halted for second day.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) on Wednesday halted for the second consecutive session a rise in the stock price of investment holding firm RFC Inc.
The bourse' surveillance department said the freeze order was issued in early trade when the price of RFC soared from nine pesos to 13.50 pesos or by 50 percent.
One thousand RFC shares were traded when the freeze order was issued, the bourse added.
The PSE issued the same order on Tuesday when the issue climbed by 50 percent.
The bourse asked the company to explain the sudden surge in the stock's price but the firm said in its reply it was not aware of any material information that caused the rise.

The stock exchange automatically freezes the price of an issue that climbs by 50 percent or close to it within a single trading session. The issue can then be traded at or below the price at which it was frozen.
The PSE recently said it would suspend trading of a stock if a company failed to immediately explain why its shares had reached the ceiling.
